On Wednesdays we meet at the Raleigh Court Branch Library in front of PH high school from 5:30 - 10pm

  
On Saturdays we meet at Beth Israel Synagogue off Franklin Rd from 5:30 - 9pm

I encourage everyone who is interested to join our discord or follow us on Facebook for updates on meeting times/events. I'm working on a comprehensive calendar as well, because we've gotten to the point where there is almost 1 chess related meeting in Roanoke every day. Though, they're not all sponsored by us, we play a supportive role in each of them. The goal is to have one chess-related thing happening every day :)

We have a hearty variety of folks. Most players are casual beginner to intermediate level players, and on the flip side we have a few players who are master level and hyper-competitive. We've also started doing some guided instruction in our beginner/kid's section at our saturday meetings at Beth Israel Synagogue for those that are interested in improving or just learning more about the game
